name: Dormitory
source:
Main character is forced to study abroad in London. He somehow finds a place to stay, but it turns out to be a boarding house for women. Only five girls know his secret that a man lives in a girl dormitory. Surrounded by attractive unique girls his days of joy are about to begin.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角被迫去伦敦留学。他不知怎么找到了一个住处，但结果却是一间女性寄宿处。只有五个女孩知道他的秘密：一个男人住在女生宿舍。在充满魅力的独特女孩的包围下，他的快乐日子即将开始。

[编辑自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
